title: beta-nebula-six-image-raw-ledger-v623

Added typed artifact replay, byte/SHA-256 recomputation, source/path/MIME/dimension checks, fixture and synthetic negative paths, and an acquisition policy ledger with retry/backoff and release gate summaries.
Connected the V623 expansion ledger to the nebula review panel while preserving candidate-only, hold, not-admitted and scientificPayloadWriteback=false boundaries.
